requested_operation: make shared-group selection authoritative for every compiled contract projection

inputs.trigger: A second forward compile retained a detached-resource sentence after security_limits was removed from shared_groups.

root_cause.symptom: Capability derivation honored shared_groups, but security_contract and preservation_contract did not.
root_cause.cause: The assembler unconditionally copied portfolio preservation, security, and quality groups into fixed contract sections.
root_cause.structural_weakness: One policy selector controlled only one projection, so a locally valid family could still acquire foreign obligations elsewhere in the generated document.

solution.selection_rule: Every shared contract section is now projected only when its group is selected.
solution.family_fallback_rule: A family excluding shared preservation or security must provide explicit preservation_defaults and security_defaults.limits; validation and compilation fail closed when either is absent.
solution.regression_rule: SafeTensors compilation scans the complete canonical document for all excluded family concepts.

tests_run: family policy validation, expanded shared-policy exclusions, and missing family-default negatives: pass
compiler readiness, determinism, schema, registry transition, and full-document SafeTensors exclusion scan: pass
open_gaps: The committed repaired inputs must now be forward-compiled and validated before the SafeTensors contract receipt closes.
